high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "games_of_thrones_club." The post is a birthday tribute to Carice van Houten, who played Melisandre in the TV series Game of Thrones. The post includes two images side by side: Left Image: A woman with long brown hair is flexing her bicep while wearing a black strapless dress. She has red lipstick on and appears to be at a formal event, as there are other people in the background, some of whom are also dressed formally. Right Image: Another woman with long dark red hair
